Topics · Hard times

How do I find rest when my mind won't stop?

No promise of a silent mind. Hearts finding rest, a prayer for a wider chest, a weight named then set down.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured."

Quran · Ar-Ra'd 13:28

Translation

Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name! Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

Original · Hebrew

לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל־קְ֝רָבַ֗י אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה וְאַל־תִּ֝שְׁכְּחִ֗י כָּל־גְּמוּלָֽיו׃

the Psalms · 103:1-2

World English Bible

The verse says hearts find rest in remembering God. It does not say minds fall silent. Hearts settle. So a restless mind is not told to empty itself, but shown a place to put its weight. The remembering can be a single word, said slowly, in place of the replay that never ends.

A question for you

What does the night replay for you?

If you sayWhat I said.
ThenWords that are gone cannot be fetched back, but they can be left with One who knows the intention. The next step has a prayer for a tight chest.
If you sayWhat I could have done.
ThenThat door is reopened often. The verse does not ask you to pass judgment on it tonight.
If you sayWhat may happen tomorrow.
ThenThere is a whole page on worry about tomorrow, waiting for you.

Part 2 of 3

﴿قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى٢٥ وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى٢٦ وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى٢٧ يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى٢٨﴾

Translation of the meaning

[Moses] said, "My Lord, expand [i.e., relax] for me my breast [with assurance] And ease for me my task And untie the knot from my tongue That they may understand my speech.

Quran · Ta-Ha 20:25-28

Translation

Moses said to Yahweh, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”

Original · Hebrew

וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶל־יְהוָה֮ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנָי֒ לֹא֩ אִ֨ישׁ דְּבָרִ֜ים אָנֹ֗כִי גַּ֤ם מִתְּמוֹל֙ גַּ֣ם מִשִּׁלְשֹׁ֔ם גַּ֛ם מֵאָ֥ז דַּבֶּרְךָ אֶל־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֧י כְבַד־פֶּ֛ה וּכְבַ֥ד לָשׁ֖וֹן אָנֹֽכִי׃

the Torah (Exodus) · 4:10

World English Bible

In these verses Moses makes three requests: that God open his chest, ease his task, and untie the knot from his tongue so they may understand him. He did not say, make me stop thinking. He said, widen my chest. Thought is not blamed. The tightness is what is brought. What is asked is that the chest be wide enough for what it carries.

A question for you

Which is nearest to where you are?

If you sayMy chest is tight.
ThenThe prayer in these verses came from someone who said exactly this. You may say it too.
If you sayI want to stop thinking.
ThenThe verses do not ask for thinking to stop. They ask for room. Room may be what stops the spinning.
If you sayI do not know how to pray.
ThenThese are three short sentences. Start with the first only.

Part 3 of 3

﴿بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ١ وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ٢ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ٣﴾

Translation of the meaning

Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?[1944] And We removed from you your burden[1945] Which had weighed upon your back

Translator's notes

[1944] i.e., enlighten, assure and gladden your heart with guidance.

[1945] By forgiving any errors which you may have committed previously or might commit consequently. "Burden" can also refer to the anxiety experienced by the Prophet (ﷺ) at the beginning of his mission.

Quran · Ash-Sharh 94:1-3

The verses say to the Prophet: have We not opened your chest, and set down from you the burden that bent your back? A weight described as bending the back, then set down. The Quran knows what a load can do, calls it a weight on the back, and says it can be lifted. The verses do not tell how it happened for him, and do not promise it will happen for you in the same way.

A question for you

What do you need from this page now?

If you sayA word to quiet me.
ThenTake one word, as the first step suggested, and say it slowly once more.
If you sayTo know I am not alone in this.
ThenMany carry this. The Quran speaks of a tight chest and a heavy back, even among prophets.
If you sayThis has gone on for weeks and takes the colour from my days.
ThenThat deserves to be heard by someone: a doctor, a counsellor, a person you trust. Speaking to them is a kind of mercy too, and this page does not take its place.

The same in the other books

Translation

Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh? Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”

Original · Hebrew

וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו מִ֣י שָׂ֣ם פֶּה֮ לָֽאָדָם֒ א֚וֹ מִֽי־יָשׂ֣וּם אִלֵּ֔ם א֣וֹ חֵרֵ֔שׁ א֥וֹ פִקֵּ֖חַ א֣וֹ עִוֵּ֑ר הֲלֹ֥א אָנֹכִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ וְעַתָּ֖ה לֵ֑ךְ וְאָנֹכִי֙ אֶֽהְיֶ֣ה עִם־פִּ֔יךָ וְהוֹרֵיתִ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּדַבֵּֽר׃

the Torah (Exodus) · 4:11-12

World English Bible

Translation

Yahweh, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me. Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

Original · Hebrew

שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּֽעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֤ה ׀ לֹא־גָבַ֣הּ לִ֭בִּי וְלֹא־רָמ֣וּ עֵינַ֑י וְלֹֽא־הִלַּ֓כְתִּי ׀ בִּגְדֹל֖וֹת וּבְנִפְלָא֣וֹת מִמֶּֽנִּי׃ אִם־לֹ֤א שִׁוִּ֨יתִי ׀ וְדוֹמַ֗מְתִּי נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּ֭גָמֻל עֲלֵ֣י אִמּ֑וֹ כַּגָּמֻ֖ל עָלַ֣י נַפְשִֽׁי׃

You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you. Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
